pictures.scene: Durer, The Adoration of the Lamb — a woodcut in which the lamb stands with a banner inside a disc of rays while the four living creatures lean in around it and crowned elders kneel with palms below, when the lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven,

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, God Enthroned — a bearded figure in a jewelled triple crown and a deep red robe seated against gold rays and a carved inscribed arch, for about half an hour, and i saw the seven angels who stand before god,
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned

pictures.scene: Durer, The Seven Angels with the Trumpets — a woodcut in which winged angels take long trumpets from the enthroned ancient of days while another swings a censer above an altar and fire falls on the sea below, and they were given seven trumpets, then another angel who had a golden censer,
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_seven_angels_with_the_trumpets

pictures.scene: King David Kneeling — a crowned king in a gilt pictorial cope worn over armour kneeling with his harp while an angel sweeps in above him and an open book is held out at his right, came and stood at the altar, he was given much incense to offer,
pictures.name: pd_king_david_kneeling_before_an_altar

pictures.scene: Millet, The Angelus — a woman standing alone in a dim evening field with her head bowed and her hands folded over her apron, a basket at her feet and a far church spire on the horizon, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne,
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_angelus

pictures.scene: Apocalypse Manuscript, The Elders Enthroned — an illuminated page where an angel blows a long trumpet over a seated haloed witness while crowds kneel with raised hands toward christ in a mandorla, and the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints,
pictures.name: pd_apocalypse_elders_enthroned

pictures.scene: Gottlieb, Jews Praying in the Synagogue — a packed synagogue of men in striped prayer shawls pressed around a torah scroll in its embroidered mantle while women look down from the gallery above, rose up before god from the hand of the angel, then the angel took the censer,
pictures.name: pd_gottlieb_jews_praying_on_yom_kippur

pictures.scene: Kroyer, Midsummer Eve Bonfire — a tall bonfire flaring sideways at dusk with villagers in hats standing close around it and children dancing in the glow, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth,
pictures.name: pd_kroyer_midsummer_eve_bonfire

pictures.scene: Cropsey, The Clove Storm — lightning splitting a brown black storm sky above snapped and splintered trees while white water pours over red rock below, and there were peals of thunder and rumblings, and flashes of lightning and an earthquake,
pictures.name: pd_cropsey_the_clove_storm

pictures.scene: Grunewald, The Concert of Angels — angels kneeling with viols and bows inside a carved gothic canopy of gold columns and foliage while a crowned radiant figure glows at the right, and the seven angels with the seven trumpets, prepared to sound them,
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_the_concert_of_angels

pictures.scene: Heade, Approaching Thunderstorm — a thin fork of lightning under a black bank of cloud over flat dark water with one man rowing a small boat and a furled white sail over the rocks in front, then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood,
pictures.name: pd_heade_approaching_thunderstorm

pictures.scene: Verschuier, The Fire of London — a city burning along the waterfront under a red smoke sky while boats crowded with people pull away across the river, were hurled down upon the earth, a third of the earth was burned up,
pictures.name: pd_verschuier_fire_of_london

pictures.scene: Bierstadt, The Redwoods — giant redwood trunks rising out of misty light above a small waterfall and pool with two tiny figures on the rock below, along with a third of the trees, and all the green grass,
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_redwoods

pictures.scene: Wright of Derby, Vesuvius in Eruption — molten red lava spilling down the mountain toward a moonlit sea under a dark canopy of smoke, then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire,
pictures.name: pd_wright_of_derby_vesuvius_in_eruption

pictures.scene: Aivazovsky, The Ninth Wave — a great green and gold wave rearing up at sunrise over survivors clinging to the wreck of a mast, was thrown into the sea, a third of the sea turned to blood,
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_the_ninth_wave

pictures.scene: Backhuysen, Ships in Distress off a Rocky Coast — a dutch ship heeling hard past a rock in white breaking surf under a grey storm sky, a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed,
pictures.name: pd_backhuysen_ships_in_distress_off_a_rocky_coast

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, The Starry Night — a swirling blue night sky of yellow burning stars above a dark cypress and a sleeping village with its church spire, then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch,
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_the_starry_night

pictures.scene: Cuyp, River Landscape — two horsemen halted at the edge of a wide still river where one horse drinks, a church spire standing in the distance beyond them, fell from heaven and landed, on a third of the rivers,
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_river_landscape

pictures.scene: Ruisdael, A Waterfall — white water breaking over boulders below a wooded bluff with a bare mountain rising behind and no one in sight, and on the springs of water, the name of the star is wormwood,
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_a_waterfall

pictures.scene: Friedrich, The Sea of Ice — shattered slabs of ice driven up into a pile over the crushed timbers of a ship, a third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil, and many people died from the bitter waters,
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_sea_of_ice

pictures.scene: Martin, Joshua Commanding the Sun to Stand Still — the sun held in a ring of torn cloud casting its rays over a vast white city while armies wind across the plain below, then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck,
pictures.name: pd_martin_joshua_commanding_the_sun_to_stand_still

pictures.scene: Friedrich, The Monk by the Sea — an immense pale grey sky over a black sea with one small robed figure alone on the dune, a third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light,
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_the_monk_by_the_sea

pictures.scene: Liljefors, Sea Eagles — one sea eagle dropping with its wings raised and its talons open while another grips its catch on the grey rolling water, and a third of the night as well, and as i observed i heard an eagle flying overhead,
pictures.name: pd_liljefors_sea_eagles

pictures.scene: Bauernfeind, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the domes and walls of the city at dusk seen across the valley with people on the road below, calling in a loud voice, woe woe woe to those who dwell on the earth,
pictures.name: pd_bauernfeind_jerusalem_from_the_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: Dore, The Heavenly Host — an engraved funnel of winged hosts spiralling away around a single blazing point of light with two dark robed figures watching from below, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded, by the remaining three angels,
pictures.name: pd_dore_the_heavenly_host

lines.text: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal,
there was silence in heaven
for about half an hour.
And I saw the seven angels who stand before God,
and they were given seven trumpets.
Then another angel, who had a golden censer,
came and stood at the altar.
He was given much incense to offer,
along with the prayers of all the saints,
on the golden altar before the throne.
And the smoke of the incense,
together with the prayers of the saints,
rose up before God from the hand of the angel.
Then the angel took the censer,
filled it with fire from the altar,
and hurled it to the earth;
and there were peals of thunder, and rumblings,
and flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
And the seven angels with the seven trumpets
prepared to sound them.
Then the first angel sounded his trumpet,
and hail and fire mixed with blood
were hurled down upon the earth.
A third of the earth was burned up,
along with a third of the trees
and all the green grass.
Then the second angel sounded his trumpet,
and something like a great mountain burning with fire
was thrown into the sea.
A third of the sea turned to blood,
a third of the living creatures in the sea died,
and a third of the ships were destroyed.
Then the third angel sounded his trumpet,
and a great star burning like a torch
fell from heaven and landed
on a third of the rivers
and on the springs of water.
The name of the star is Wormwood.
A third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil,
and many people died from the bitter waters.
Then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet,
and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck.
A third of the stars were darkened,
a third of the day was without light,
and a third of the night as well.
And as I observed, I heard an eagle flying overhead,
calling in a loud voice,
Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth,
because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded
by the remaining three angels!
